name: default
description: Global defaults. Mid-latitude cloud heights and rough stage boundaries; the starting point that regional packs override.

stages.name: golden_hour
stages.morning_description: Low, warm light as the sun climbs. Clouds near the sun glow gold and shadows are long.
stages.description: Low, warm, directional light and long shadows. Clouds near the sun glow gold.

stages.name: sunset_glow
stages.morning_description: Sun just rising. Orange-red light on low and mid clouds; the eastern horizon is brightest.
stages.description: Sun just set. Orange-red light still reaches low and mid clouds; the western horizon is brightest.

stages.name: afterglow
stages.morning_description: High clouds catch sunlight first, above Earth's shadow, while the ground is still dim. Colour depends on grazing height, see grazing_colours.
stages.description: High clouds still catch sunlight above Earth's shadow while the ground is dim. Colour here depends on grazing height, see grazing_colours.

stages.name: purple_light
stages.morning_description: Violet-pink glow building in the east. Only the highest cloud toward the horizon is lit.
stages.description: Fading violet-pink. Only the highest cloud toward the horizon is lit; the grey-blue shadow band climbs in the east.

stages.name: blue_hour
stages.morning_description: Deep blue sky slowly brightening. The best window before sunrise for twilight and star work.
stages.description: Deep blue sky, cloud colour mostly gone. Time to switch to twilight and star work.
